newsitem.title: GERMANY: Grundig results in line with plan.
newsitem.headline: Grundig results in line with plan.

text.p: Grundig AG said on Monday it was unaffected by parent company Philips Electronics NV's profit warning and that its own results are in line with plans.
No further restructuring steps are planned at Grundig, particularly regarding the work force, it said.
"Grundig hopes to counter speculation that the accelerated elimination of 6,000 jobs in the Philips Group could also affect (Grundig)", the company said in a statement.
Grundig's own restructuring programme is following plan, it said.
Grundig reported in March a record 597.8 million mark loss for 1995, and said it plans to slash costs drastically, including 3,000 layoffs, adding to the 1,800 made last year.
